_comment: Instance data for core/scripts/decision-review.py: regex strings (case-insensitive) ADDED to the English
built-ins. unneeded = the human's reply to a question says it was needless ('just do it'); overreach = the
human corrects an action for not asking first; referral = the AI's reply sends a matter to a human;
referral_correction = a later prompt that names such a referral ('you recommended asking the human');
action_words = words that tie a correction to the action. Put the operator's own language here, one
regex per phrase the operator really uses; the built-ins in the script show the shape.
